description: The recommended image sizes in pixels for a social or shop platform, print or the web: posts, stories, covers, thumbnails, banners, profile photos and more. Leave platform empty to list every platform. Each size comes with a link that opens the Six-IR resizer set to that size.

kind.description: Optional: only sizes whose name contains this, for example "story", "thumbnail", "banner" or "profile".

platform.description: For example Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest, Etsy, Amazon, Twitch, Discord, print or web.

name: get_image_sizes
title: Get image sizes for a platform
